init_object_detection_pipeline: create an ObjectDetectionPipeline instance by loading a doctR object detection model from the HuggingFace Hub using a model ID
run_object_detection: run object detection on a PIL Image and return a list of detected objects with labels, scores, and bounding boxes
get_detection_results: get the detection results as a list of dicts containing label, score, and box keys for each detected object
review_transform_pipeline: review the ObjectDetectionPipeline transform configuration that converts PIL images to float32 tensors using PILToTensor and ConvertImageDtype
summarize_output_format: summarize the object detection output format returning dicts with label, score, and box keys containing xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax coordinates
